method: Each case driven through the real UI: app cold start, DocumentsUI file picker (Show roots -> Downloads), source row, target chip, target-named Convert action. Outputs then verified twice: MediaStore content query on content://media/external/downloads (relative_path Download/Sigha/) and a host-side byte check of the pulled file (magic bytes, byte size). OCR case additionally installed the 28 MB English+Arabic pack through the in-app confirmation dialog before converting.

outputs: Download/Sigha/law.png plus law (1)..(20).png - 21 PNGs, one per page, 177,548-473,589 B each, PNG magic on both checked pages
Download/Sigha/law.txt (35,346 B, 791 lines of real extracted text)
cases.automationNote: The driver missed the transient completion banner and timed out after 150 s, but the app had written the file at 20:28 and the History row 'law.txt - PDF to TXT - 35 kB' is present; output and history are the evidence.

notes: History row carries the typed fidelity note: 'Images and tables were not rendered; headings and lists were kept.'

outputs: Download/Sigha/notes (1).pdf (16,123 B, %PDF-1.4); the source name collides with the previous case, and the app made the unique name itself
Download/Sigha/uitest1.txt (273 B of OCR text; the screenshot's own UI text was recognised: 'Sigha', 'Your files, converted on this phone', 'Nothing is uploaded - everything happens on your device')
details: In-app dialog 'Download model pack? OCR: English + Arabic (28 MB) downloads once and works offline afterwards' confirmed via Download button

Download progressed to completion while the screen was on the workbench (progress 'Downloading... 49%' observed); the pack installed and the Text/TXT target appeared on the same screen without reselecting the file

legacySavePath.artefact: app-universal-release.apk (Gradle-built release universal APK, QA key)
legacySavePath.output: /sdcard/Download/Sigha/uitest1.jpg (117,784 B, FF D8 FF E0 JPEG magic)
legacySavePath.detail: On API 26-28 the app writes straight to Download/Sigha and does not insert into MediaStore Downloads; the UI reported the save, the file is on disk, and the automation's MediaStore query correctly returned nothing. This proves the legacy write path end to end on a release build.
